# Paths skipped by .github/scripts/secret-scan.sh.
#
# This mirrors the secret-exclusion patterns in .gitignore, plus the generated
# fixtures that legitimately contain large placeholder blobs (hex hashes, not
# secrets).
#
# Note: `*.pem` and `secrets/` from .gitignore are deliberately NOT exempted.
# A committed PEM private-key block must still fail the scan, so a tracked PEM
# file is always inspected.

packages/contracts/contracts/attestar/src/fixtures.rs
apps/web/lib/vk.json
